snippet.title: Otroci Rešijo Princeske V Pravljičnem Svetu! Zgodba O Pomaganju Drugim!
snippet.description:
Otroci Rešijo Princeske V Pravljičnem Svetu! Zgodba O Pomaganju Drugim!
#BoNaNuKidsShow #Otroci #Igrače #VideoposnetkiZaOtroke


👑 Otroci Rešijo Princeske V Pravljičnem Svetu! ✨💖

Pridružite se otrokom na čudoviti pravljični pustolovščini, kjer bodo pomagali princeskam premagati težave in doživeti nepozabne trenutke! 🌸🧚‍♀️

Skozi to zabavno zgodbo se naučite, kako pomembni so prijaznost, prijateljstvo in pomoč drugim. Ali bodo otroci uspešno rešili princeske? Oglejte si do konca! 🏰💕

Dobrodošli v BoNaNu Kids Show – kraju žarečih nasmehov in neskončnega raziskovanja! 🚀

Smo destinacija za vse družine, ki imajo rade poučne in zabavne videoposnetke za majhne otroke. Tukaj boste našli:
✨ Ustvarjalne učne dejavnosti: Pomagajo vašemu malčku, da se na zelo enostaven in zabaven način spozna s črkami, številkami, barvami in svetom okoli sebe.
✨ Raziskovanje sveta igrač: Skupaj z malčkom odpirajte škatle (unboxing), se igrajte in ustvarjajte z najbolj zanimivimi igračami.
✨ Družinski trenutki: Deljenje veselih trenutkov, avantur in ljubkih izzivov s celotno družino.
✨ DIY ideje in ročna dela: Spodbujanje ustvarjalnosti in spretnosti vašega malčka skozi preproste in edinstvene ustvarjalne projekte.

Ustvarimo čudovite spomine z BoNaNu Kids Show in vzgojimo ljubezen do učenja pri vašem otroku! Ne pozabite se NAROČITI na kanal in klikniti na zvonec za obvestila, da ne zamudite nobenega novega videa!
Vse zvokovne in vizualne vsebine na tem kanalu so v lasti BONA MEDIA.

snippet.title: Jax sneaks a gift for his ex, the decoy plan gets busted in two minutes 🍍 #shorts  #comedy  #funny
snippet.description:
a wall-snooping neighbor, a folded paper pineapple gift for an ex, and a honey-trap decoy that falls apart in two minutes.

The kick-off — Jason kicks the front door over with Jax still attached to it: the next time I see you, I beat you up every single time. Ollie plays innocent: what is going on here? Jax talks tough: I am not scared of you — come hit me if you dare. The moment Jason turns around, Jax panics straight into the closet. Big brother, what happened? This brat is obviously bad news — he keeps peeping at my sister over the wall. Ollie hands over a bottle of wine to smooth it over: calm down, maybe it is all a misunderstanding. There will be no next time — and Jason walks off with the wine. Come out, Jax, they are gone. Why were you watching his sister anyway? 🚪

The pineapple hunt — Jax ransacks the room, drawers flying everywhere: have you seen a pineapple? What pineapple? The one folded out of paper. Did not see it. He digs it out himself and announces he is heading out. What is up with him, asks Jesse — let us follow and see, decides Ollie. At the exit Jax refuses to take them along, so he simply unhooks the cargo bed off the tricycle and rides away alone. The two of them still track him down flat against the wall: what are you looking at? Quiet! Who is that girl? 🍍

The wall whisper — It is my ex-girlfriend, Jax hisses. Your ex?! Quiet! You broke up and you are still sneaking peeks — do you still like her? Not at all — I just want to return this to her. Then hand it over directly — why are you crouching here? Her brother is right there, I do not dare. And then Ollie gets an idea: the honey trap. As he says it, his eyes slide straight toward Jesse. 🤫

The decoy bust — Scene change: Jesse steps out in full drag: big brother, do you really think this works? Relax — dressed up like this you could charm anyone, her brother included. Fine, I will give it a try. Good luck! Jesse walks in — and within two minutes he is kicked out the door, the disguise seen through at a glance, fleeing for his life. Take all your stuff and get lost! Jason flings the paper pineapple away, turns his head — and spots Ollie crouched right beside him, camera up. Oops. Ollie runs, Jason chases. 👗

snippet.title: Promised a trip to the sea - delivered a golden wheat field 😅 #shorts  #comedy  #tricks
snippet.description:
an invitation to "go see the sea" lands in a golden wheat field — one brother drags a whole bed to force the other along, then uses the same trick on the youngest, until "a few acres of corn" send the original schemer running.

The golden sea — Jax kicks the door open: do you want to go see the sea? Where? It is very close to here. Stop messing around — how could there be a sea around here? Why not? It is really close. And just as he says it, the wheat-harvesting tool drops to the floor. The sea you mean is a golden one, right? How did you know? If you want me to help you harvest the wheat, just say so — it is not like I would refuse. Fine — then come help me cut the wheat. I am not going. Will you go or not? No. 🌊

The dragged bed — A grunt and the sound of a bed being dragged across the floor — Ollie pokes his head out of the covers and finds Jax has dragged the entire bed to the front gate. Stop pulling — I will go, all right? Scene change: the moment Ollie steps into the wheat field he wants to bolt. What are you doing? Jax, I really cannot take it — this much wheat, when will we ever finish? If you leave, what about me? Can I find someone to take my place? In this heat, who would take your place? 🌾

The same trick — Ollie kicks open the front door, startling Jesse: little brother, do you want to go see the sea? The sea? Really — when do we leave? Right now. Is that not a bit sudden? Spur-of-the-moment is good — there might be surprises. Which sea are we going to? Secret for now — you will know when we get there. So Jesse appears in the wheat field in swim trunks, swim cap and goggles, a swim ring in hand. Let me swap your gear — this is more like it. Get to work. A hard day for you two. No worries — good brothers help each other, and you can return the favor at my place. Did you not already harvest your wheat? Right. Good. But there are still a few acres of corn. 🏊

The corn reveal — Scene change: the three stand in front of the cornfield — Jax looks at it in disbelief, while Ollie and Jesse both just stare at him. Jax wants no part of the work and bolts on the spot — with the two brothers chasing after him. 🏃

snippet.description:

যে মায়ের আঁচল ধরে ছেলে একদিন বড় হয়েছিল, সেই ছেলেই কি না মাকে বৃদ্ধাশ্রমে ফেলে যাওয়ার পরিকল্পনা করল! মায়ের সম্পত্তি দখল করে বিদেশ যাওয়ার স্বপ্ন দেখল আপনজনেরা। কিন্তু তারা জানত না, ভাগ্যের চাকা একদিন ঘুরে যাবে! বৃদ্ধাশ্রমে ফেলে যাওয়া সেই মা-ই এমন এক সিদ্ধান্ত নেবেন, যা বদলে দেবে সবার জীবন!
